book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 6 The Call of the Challenger 挑战者号的召唤
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修第四册 Unit 6 词表(p62-72 真词)+ 单元课文中的同主题真词(航天/探索/勇气);IPA 标准词典英音;例句原创、太空探索主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Astronauts soon become accustomed to floating in zero gravity.
words.example_cn: 宇航员很快就习惯了在零重力下漂浮。

words.example_en: People have grown used to the notion of space travel.
words.example_cn: 人们已经习惯了太空旅行这个概念。

words.example_en: Everyone knew the first Moon landing was a hazardous undertaking.
words.example_cn: 人人都知道首次登月是一项危险的行动。

words.example_en: By the 1980s, space travel had become unexceptional to the public.
words.example_cn: 到了20世纪80年代,太空旅行对公众来说已是平常事。

words.example_en: The Challenger space shuttle took off on 28 January 1986.
words.example_cn: 挑战者号航天飞机于1986年1月28日升空。

words.example_en: This flight was no ordinary excursion into space.
words.example_cn: 这次飞行可不是一次普通的太空出行。

words.example_en: Christa hoped to rekindle public interest in the space programme.
words.example_cn: 克丽斯塔希望重新唤起公众对太空计划的兴趣。

words.example_en: Tragically, the teacher never returned to her classroom.
words.example_cn: 不幸的是,这位老师再也没能回到她的教室。

words.example_en: Instantaneously, excitement turned into terror.
words.example_cn: 瞬间,兴奋变成了恐惧。

words.example_en: The disaster cast a long shadow on people's hearts.
words.example_cn: 这场灾难在人们心头投下了长长的阴影。

words.example_en: When the shuttle exploded, the students all started to scream.
words.example_cn: 当航天飞机爆炸时,学生们都尖叫起来。

words.example_en: Space shuttle flights were suspended for nearly three years.
words.example_cn: 航天飞机的飞行被暂停了将近三年。

words.meaning_cn: 全体机组人员;全体船员
words.example_en: All seven members of the crew were lost in the accident.
words.example_cn: 机组的七名成员全部在这场事故中遇难。

words.example_en: At the camp I tried a week of simulated space flight.
words.example_cn: 在营地我体验了一周的模拟太空飞行。

words.example_en: Trainees practise in a modern flight simulator before any real mission.
words.example_cn: 学员在真正执行任务前先在现代飞行模拟器里训练。

words.example_en: The training felt so lifelike that I almost forgot it was not real.
words.example_cn: 这训练太逼真了,我几乎忘了它并不是真的。

words.example_en: You must submit a short video to apply for the space programme.
words.example_cn: 你必须提交一段短视频来申请这个太空项目。

words.example_en: Walking in zero gravity was an awesome experience.
words.example_cn: 在零重力下行走是一次了不起的体验。

words.example_en: A powerful telescope lets us see galaxies far beyond our own.
words.example_cn: 一台强大的望远镜让我们看到远在自身之外的星系。

words.example_en: When the first telescope was angled at the night sky, our view of space changed.
words.example_cn: 当第一台望远镜斜对着夜空时,我们对太空的认识改变了。

words.example_en: Our Sun is only one star among billions in the galaxy.
words.example_cn: 太阳只是这个星系中数十亿颗恒星之一。

words.example_en: The galaxies float like islands of light in a vast cosmic ocean.
words.example_cn: 众多星系如同光的岛屿漂浮在浩瀚的宇宙海洋中。

words.example_en: On some new planets we might conceivably find life one day.
words.example_cn: 在某些新行星上,我们有朝一日有可能找到生命。

words.example_en: Dark matter is thought to be made of tiny subatomic particles.
words.example_cn: 暗物质被认为是由微小的亚原子粒子构成的。

words.example_en: These particles are far too small for ordinary telescopes to see.
words.example_cn: 这些粒子太小了,普通望远镜根本看不见。

words.example_en: Dark matter is invisible to ordinary telescopes.
words.example_cn: 暗物质对普通望远镜来说是看不见的。

words.example_en: In space, even the most straightforward task can be difficult.
words.example_cn: 在太空中,即便最简单的任务也可能很困难。

words.example_en: Astronauts need self-discipline to keep their spacecraft clean.
words.example_cn: 宇航员需要自律来保持航天器清洁。

words.example_en: A vacuum cleaner is handy for fetching items that float out of reach.
words.example_cn: 吸尘器很方便,可以拿回那些漂到够不着的地方的物品。

words.example_en: Without gravity, astronauts' bones and muscles can become weak.
words.example_cn: 没有重力,宇航员的骨骼和肌肉会变得虚弱。

words.example_en: In space, salt and pepper are provided in liquid form.
words.example_cn: 在太空中,盐和胡椒粉以液体形式提供。

words.example_en: Imagine what would happen if an astronaut caught a cold and began to sneeze.
words.example_cn: 想象一下,如果宇航员感冒并开始打喷嚏会怎么样。

words.example_en: Voyager 1 carries a disc with sounds and images of Earth.
words.example_cn: 旅行者1号携带着一张录有地球声音和图像的光盘。

words.example_en: Every astronaut on board the Apollo 11 mission made it safely back to Earth.
words.example_cn: 阿波罗11号上的每一名宇航员都安全返回了地球。

words.example_en: The first satellite was sent into space in 1957.
words.example_cn: 第一颗人造卫星于1957年被送入太空。

words.example_en: Crowds waited eagerly to watch the rocket launch.
words.example_cn: 人群急切地等着观看火箭发射。

words.example_en: She planned to teach two lessons from orbit around the Earth.
words.example_cn: 她计划在地球轨道上讲两堂课。

words.example_en: The teacher wanted to explain how gravity worked in space.
words.example_cn: 这位老师想解释重力在太空中是如何起作用的。

words.example_en: The whole crew prepared carefully for the dangerous mission.
words.example_cn: 全体机组人员为这次危险的任务做了精心准备。

words.example_en: She would first demonstrate the controls of the spacecraft.
words.example_cn: 她会首先演示这艘航天器的操控装置。

words.example_en: An ordinary teacher was about to become the first civilian in space.
words.example_cn: 一位普通教师即将成为首位进入太空的平民。

words.example_en: It was the most disastrous space disaster the world had ever seen.
words.example_cn: 那是全世界所见过的最严重的太空灾难。

words.example_en: People continue to explore space despite the great risks.
words.example_cn: 尽管风险巨大,人们仍在继续探索太空。

words.example_en: The telescope showed us that the universe is far larger than we imagined.
words.example_cn: 望远镜让我们看到,宇宙远比我们想象的要大。

words.example_en: The crew re-entered the atmosphere on their way back to Earth.
words.example_cn: 机组人员在返回地球的途中重新进入大气层。

words.example_en: Engineers worked hard to investigate the cause of the disaster.
words.example_cn: 工程师们努力调查这场灾难的原因。

words.example_en: At the observatory you can learn about astronomy and watch the stars.
words.example_cn: 在天文台你可以学习天文学并观察星星。

words.example_en: Millions watched the first lunar landing on television.
words.example_cn: 数百万人在电视上观看了首次登月。

words.example_en: We must keep reaching for the stars, no matter how distant they seem.
words.example_cn: 无论星辰看上去多么遥远,我们都必须继续追寻。

words.example_en: The sacrifice of the Challenger crew still calls us to keep exploring.
words.example_cn: 挑战者号机组的牺牲仍在召唤我们继续探索。
